title: Word: Copilot Agent Mode edits documents through chat
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licence requirement and licence-assignment controls are supported. Independent searches did not establish a tenant switch, an arrival default or an Agent Mode-specific meter; the briefing appropriately leaves those points open.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Licence assignment controls who holds the general Copilot licence rather than configuring Agent Mode alone.
claims.quote: When you use the Active users page to assign or unassign licenses, you assign or unassign users licenses to products.

claims.claim: Licence assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user that you want to assign a license to. In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell assigns a licence with Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote: To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell. Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.where: controls[0].note; rendered controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Admin-centre licence assignment requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: Graph licence assignment requires User.ReadWrite.All or another permission listed in the Assign license Graph reference.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.
